name: Multi-Asset Data
description: Multi-asset (futures, options, funds, bonds) market data with CFI-aligned instrument typing (ISO 10962:2021), exchange double-field modelling, and a governance-ready storage layer that tags every bar with license, security level, origin and dataset lineage. Reuses the stock_analysis provider contract and data gateway instead of duplicating them.
author: VeroRun

settings_schema.title: Multi-Asset Data Settings
settings_schema.description: Configure the preferred market data source for futures, options, funds and bonds.

data_provider.title: Preferred Data Source
data_provider.description: Preferred source for this plugin's asset classes (empty = follow the per-asset default chain order). Only sources that actually serve futures/options/funds/bonds are listed.
